description: This PHP source file defines the 'LoginLog' entity class within the OrangeHRM project. It maps to the 'ohrm_login' database table and represents login log entries, including user-related details and login timestamps. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations and a trait for date-time helper functions.

classes.name: LoginLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a login record, with properties for user ID, name, role, login time, and associated getters and setters.
